tasks.title: Local development estate: freeze the corpus and control denominators
tasks.requested_action: Freeze the complete bounded universe for Arcadia and the place-formation slices covering Opportunity Zones, Metro joint development, TIF districts, stadium finance, Baltimore Peninsula, local land, public infrastructure, assessment governance, parcel assembly, and development rights. before interpreting recurrence or absence. Declare inclusion and exclusion rules, jurisdictions, time windows, source families, stable identifiers, as-of date, ordinary and unsuccessful controls, explicit null rows, and a reproducible snapshot fingerprint. Preserve partial and unavailable coverage rather than completing the universe by inference.
required_outputs: bounded universe with inclusion and exclusion rules
ordinary, unsuccessful, nonparticipant, or explicit-null controls
tasks.stopping_rule: Stop when the named universe and controls are fully enumerated, or when every unresolved portion is explicitly partial or unavailable with search provenance.
tasks.boundary: Public investment, zoning, ownership timing, and later value change are separable observations and do not by themselves establish capture or coordination.
tasks.resolution: Current custody is frozen for this pass: 1 primary cases, 4 primary tracks, 8 primary slices, 75 case claims, 142 case receipt references, and 64 slice records. Inclusion remains bounded by the estate definition and as-of date.
tasks.residual_fog: The macro-estate denominator remains incomplete under dominant fog missing_signed_instruments_and_parcel_cashflow_joins; ordinary, unsuccessful, nonparticipant, and explicit-null controls are not yet complete across the whole estate.
tasks.next_transition: Extend the frozen universe only through explicit inclusion rules, stable identifiers, dated source families, and retained null/control rows.

unsuccessful, withdrawn, denied, nonparticipant, and no-match rows
